sharingOwnerRules.description: All SFTS internal users (advocates, supervisors, admins) can read and edit each other''s Self-Sufficiency Matrix Assessments records. Required because advocates take assessments for each others' clients and outcomes data feeds organization-wide funder reports. External users (if any are added via Experience Cloud later) remain blocked by the Private OWD.
